checks: 非鼠标选区不创建自动工具栏
原生 NSTextView 选区经 Swift/AX 自动读取；浮标显示且不抢焦点、不自动请求模型
AX 选区暂时消失后，鼠标移向并进入工具栏仍保留原文本与可见工具栏
点击原生浮标后翻译浮窗使用真实选区、完成本机流式请求；Mac 提供复制结果
主界面保持打开时，词典浮窗可用，原应用保持前台，主界面仍在原应用后面
非激活输入浮窗可接收键盘输入，自身划选不误弹工具栏，点击外部可收起
真实 Option+T 全局快捷键刷新原生选区并完成翻译（未注入测试选区或快捷键回调）
清空选区和进入安全密码框后不保留可用选区

independentPanels: Input shortcut focuses editor; Enter translates; Shift+Enter and IME composition do not submit
A new shortcut opens a second window without cancelling or replacing the pinned window's running request
Dock remains available and pinned results survive closing/reopening settings
Unpinned window is reused; settings do not dismiss pinned windows
Short input window stays on the cursor's display with its nearest edge within 24 DIP
Image import from a pinned result opens another window and preserves the original session
scope: Local Cocoa and packaged-app regression with actual CGEvent mouse/keyboard input, window order and foreground PID checks; no chat messages or external AI services.
